kjv: the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up
mine: the earth and the works that are done on it will be exposed
note: TR "katakaesetai" (will be burned up) against "heurethesetai" (will be found / laid bare; Sinaiticus, B, P72 vid). The early text speaks of the earth exposed to judgment, not annihilated; the reading is so difficult that many editors suspect corruption.

kjv: hasting unto the coming of the day of God
mine: waiting for and hastening the coming of the day of God
note: speudontas is "hastening" (bringing it nearer by holy living), not "hasting unto"; the KJV makes believers hurry towards the day rather than speed its coming.
